hypotheses: M is the complete implemented square-system matrix
h is positive and differentiable on each smooth segment
nu is differentiable on each smooth segment
interface transfer T is square, finite and nonsingular
one-sided interface values and orientation are explicit

actual stellar profile and interface data
source-backed mode spectrum or physical mode identity
